not_verified: Pose is fixed: joints are placed instances, not mates, and do not articulate
Springs are smooth rods, not coils; no power cord modelled
Shade neck stands 4 mm off the head joint disc; an exactly tangent neck made that pair's interference boolean uncertain
Bulb is a plain sphere: no socket, filament or wiring
No tip-over or joint-strength analysis; centre of mass reported, not tested

Running `ryucad check` inside this repo adds 4 warnings about the parent checkout's missing ryucad git drivers/hooks (.gitattributes, merge driver, pre-commit hooks) - a property of the repo, not the model; the quoted check result is the model's own
one_line: An articulated architect's desk lamp in orange enamel: domed base with clevis, twin-bar arms (210/190 mm) on shared disc-and-cap joints, exposed spring rods, and a hollow bell shade with a bulb, posed leaning back with the head over the base.
poses: anglepoise stance: lower arm 32 deg from vertical, upper arm -38 deg, shade aimed (0.94, 0, -0.34) down-forward
specs: Base: revolved dome, r85 foot, clevis cheeks bored r7.5; joint part (x3): disc r17, through cap r7, centre bore r4.5; arm cross pins r4 run in the bores
Arms: lower 210 mm, upper 190 mm, twin bars at y +/-11 with pins; bars stop 8 mm short of joint centres to clear the caps
Shade: bell shell of two revolved profiles (outer + inner cut), rim r52, 2.5 mm wall, slim r9 neck; bulb sphere r11, cream #fff2cf
Joints at (0, 0, 44), (111.3, 0, 222.1) and (-5.7, 0, 371.8); overall height about 390 mm
Mass 1.617 kg, volume 529,449 mm^3, centre of mass (14.6, 0, 84.6) mm; enamel #d96c33 over aluminium density, steel joints/springs/pins
title: Articulated desk lamp
